title: feat: name sandboxes, with a generated name by default
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: The Create sandbox dialog now suggests an editable name such as `brave-otter` and saves nonblank names as E2B `metadata.name`. Sandbox cards and the resume/time dialog show the name, falling back to the sandbox ID for unnamed sandboxes. `polli sandbox list` adds a name column. The sandbox docs explain how API callers can set `metadata.name` at creation and that E2B metadata cannot be changed afterward. The existing API-key name generator was moved to a shared helper; key naming behavior is unchanged.
